name: Shared data from snapshot tables (SOURCE=objects)
summary: Page -> serve -> session -> load_shared -> cache.get -> tracked(read_shared) -> snapshot(old=cache.last): the same RUN_ID -> one small query; else the TBL_ACCESS_ tables WORKERS at a time via sf.rows; Rebuild CALLs SP_ACCESS_SNAPSHOT in a background refresh (renew: parts under KEY.new, built, swapped in, compared)

name: Shared data read directly (SOURCE=direct)
summary: Load shared data click -> reload(load) -> tracked() -> cache.get -> access.live(): probes in one wave (DATABASES included; a lost session or no warehouse stops the load), readable ACCOUNT_USAGE views WORKERS at a time, one ACCESS_HISTORY scan; database list once (AU -> INFORMATION_SCHEMA -> SHOW), grants AU else SHOW, schema list -> SHOW FUTURE GRANTS, users, usage, tags, policies, streams AU else SHOW, object inventory OWNERSHIP rows -> run RUN_ID direct with SOURCES and NOTES -> memory + .cache

name: Web API request
summary: Browser fetch -> same_site middleware (Host, Origin, Sec-Fetch-Site) -> route -> serve -> session -> ROUTES handler -> JSON

name: Streamlit in Snowflake
summary: app.py -> st_react.app component -> shown() (answer() in a thread, progress lines in a box) -> server.py functions; INSIDE session, never closed, memory only, My access hidden

name: My access
summary: POST /api/mine/load -> mine_off checks -> access.mine() with the user's own rights (ACCOUNT_USAGE first, SHOW GRANTS TO ROLE only when refused, a lost session stops) -> MINE[sid] + ae_sid cookie -> view=mine pages

name: Startup
summary: run.py parses mode/port/source, sets env, starts server.py (uvicorn 8000) or streamlit app.py (8501); server import runs cache.config

name: What changed
summary: renew -> cache.swap -> store -> keep_prev (<key>.prev.pkl) -> compared(d) while the replaced set is still built -> diff_of -> a.diff(facts, moved_blocks, grant_events; first EVENT_NAMES names per event) -> memo + .cache/<key>.diff.pkl; changes_page: cache.prev (fake: fake_previous), diff_of, subject and f filters, one page (offset, limit) with events_total, first NAMES ids per event

name: serve
summary: JSON answer of one endpoint: session + ROUTES handler + refs + clean

name: session
summary: The view's lookups built under LOCK; S holds sensitive objects, rule rows and graph rule hits; rule results come from kept_rules() when kept, else are checked and saved.

name: load_shared
summary: Shared data: memory or .pkl at once; Direct mode with no copy and no parts -> 409 shared_not_loaded (read only on a click); a page never waits behind a load (LOAD.acquire non-blocking -> 409 shared_loading); else tracked(KEY, "shared", stages); a read error -> 503 shared_unreadable.

name: read_shared
summary: The shared data from its source, reads kept as parts of key (a refresh uses KEY + ".new"): fake() / with_query(live(old ACTIVITY, OBJECT_USE from cache.old)) / with_query(snapshot(old=cache.last(KEY))): the run held costs one TBL_ACCESS_RUN query.

name: with_query
summary: fn(query) with query(sql) -> list of dicts; the connection is made at the first statement (one login across each()'s threads, a failed login fails every statement as ConnectionError), so a load answered from parts logs in to nothing; key: query wrapped by cache.parted (OFFLINE: parts only); a lost session is raised after fn (no empty data set), a whole load prunes the parts not asked for; closed only when sf.owned().

name: reload
summary: POST /api/reload: OFFLINE refuses all but load (BUILD_ONLY_NOTE); load = load_shared(); fake mode drops the copy; else refresh(what).

name: meta
summary: App metadata: mode, source, pages, mine_available, inside, csv (csv_on, server.py:4069), run, notes

name: home_page
summary: Home: the default (or own) user's ladder counts, account risks by severity, data protection tiles; skipped rules in the shared view, so Home says its counts leave them out (server.py:1893).

name: changes_page
summary: What changed JSON: mine view and no previous snapshot -> reason; diff_of(prev); events about subject=, counts, text (says when a capped event may miss the subject), f= filter (all, gain, lose, risk, sensitive), one page by offset= / limit= with events_total, each event's people / objects / subjects cut to the first NAMES (20) plus the subject

name: mine_off
summary: Why My access is off: INSIDE, MY_ACCESS, HOST not loopback or ALLOWED_HOSTS naming another host, key-pair login

name: load_mine
summary: My access: cache.get(mine key, with_query(a.mine, key)) with parts, its time the oldest part's; fresh clears its parts and drops the copy; OFFLINE + fresh -> 409 build_only.

name: mine_entry
summary: MINE entry of a sid, dropped after TTL

name: allowed_hosts
summary: Host names served: loopback, HOST, machine names/IPs on 0.0.0.0, ALLOWED_HOSTS

name: make_app
summary: FastAPI app: gzip, same_site middleware, error handlers, /api routes, SPA

name: same_site
summary: Middleware: 400 bad_host, 403 cross_site (Origin, Sec-Fetch-Site); a client gone mid-answer (RuntimeError, is_disconnected) -> 204, no traceback

name: mine_load
summary: POST /api/mine/load: new sid, load_mine, ae_sid cookie

name: config
summary: (mode, source, where) from FAKE / SOURCE / ACCESS_SNAPSHOT

name: name
summary: Cache key: account + source + location + user + role

name: get
summary: (data, fetched_at): from memory, else the local file, else store(key, fn()); the read runs under its key's own lock (lock(key)), so another key never waits.

name: ready
summary: Whether get() answers without reading the source

name: drop
summary: Read again next time: out of memory under the key's lock (the memory copy kept in OLD, so last() still finds it inside Snowflake), and the local file set aside.

name: keep_prev
summary: The local file this read replaces (or the one drop() set aside) becomes <key>.prev.pkl unless it is the same run or an empty no-run read (RUN_ID None).

name: prev
summary: (data, mtime) of the previous snapshot kept locally

name: local
summary: Local file allowed: CACHE_HOURS > 0 and not INSIDE

name: sql_copy
summary: Write data set d to .cache/access.duckdb, schema schema(key): this read as the TBL_ACCESS_ tables, the read before as _PREV, under SQL_LOCK and access.step("DuckDB copy"); per table one INSERT ... SELECT TRY_CAST from a registered Arrow table of text columns (pyarrow), else from UNNESTed text lists; a note without duckdb.

name: sql_wanted
summary: Whether a read gets a SQL copy: never inside Snowflake; fake data (disk False) only with DUCKDB=1; a Snowflake read whenever a local copy may be kept (CACHE_HOURS > 0). No off switch.

name: connect
summary: INSIDE: app session; else key pair or SSO externalbrowser

name: owned
summary: Connection is ours to close (not INSIDE)

name: rows
summary: (column names, rows) of one statement; every read of the app goes through here. STATEMENT_TIMEOUT as a statement parameter (limit); a timeout raises TimeoutError naming the step and the longer setting (sf.py:57-61).

name: in_snowflake
summary: INSIDE detection: FAKE, INSIDE=0|1, active Snowpark session

name: snapshot
summary: Last OK run of the snapshot tables, asked on every load through query.fresh (always asked, never answered from a part, so a newer run shows; the answer is kept for --build): none, no RUN_ID or unreadable -> empty tables with NOTES no_run; the run held (old) and nothing UNREAD -> old back; else each TBL_ACCESS_<t> WORKERS at a time; a failed table is empty, UNAVAILABLE, noted, in UNREAD; a lost session stops the load.

name: live
summary: SOURCE=direct: the whole account read now with the caller's role, same dict as snapshot(). Per data set ACCOUNT_USAGE, else INFORMATION_SCHEMA, else SHOW (keep in step with SP_ACCESS_SNAPSHOT): probes in one wave, readable views WORKERS at a time, one database list for database roles, schema list (future grants) and object inventory; streams from ACCOUNT_USAGE.STREAMS; OWNERSHIP rows for objects no grant names. Writes nothing

name: each
summary: query(sql) for every sql, n at a time (SHOW_THREADS / WORKERS), in order, a failure as its exception, progress labels; a query wrapped by cache.parted hands the whole wave to its keep() (parts first, only the missing reads run).

name: mine
summary: My access: the logged-in user's own access, live, with their own rights; ACCOUNT_USAGE first (GRANTS_TO_ROLES of the available roles, GRANTS_TO_USERS, USERS), SHOW GRANTS TO ROLE per role only when refused, a lost session or no warehouse stops it; usage ACCOUNT_USAGE 30 days, else QUERY_HISTORY_BY_USER in 7 windows; a refused USE SECONDARY ROLES, no role list or no user become notes, never an error; rows without names left out by build().

name: only
summary: Demo of mine(): one user's slice of a data set

name: build
summary: Fill module lookups from a data set after tidy(d); same (key, builtin) skips; keeps KEEP_BUILT built sets; hides built-ins; memo["key"] is set last, so a build that stopped half way never counts as done.

name: cached
summary: fn() once per data set (memo)

name: loaded
summary: Lookups of data set d inside a block (built, or restored from a.built when its key is kept there), the loaded ones and built put back after

name: facts
summary: What a diff compares, once per data set: users' granted roles, role links, each role's own table grants (no per-user pairs), grants, user roles, findings, status, sensitive set, run, a memo for side walks

name: diff
summary: Events, counts, new/fixed findings from prev to the loaded data set; prev's kept findings reused, prev restored from a.built by key; moved_blocks for gained / lost access, pairs=False leaves the pairs out; each event names its first EVENT_NAMES people and objects (capped)

name: grant_events
summary: Gain/lose events from added/removed grants and user roles

name: event_counts
summary: Events per filter: all, gain, lose, risk, sensitive

name: fake_previous
summary: Demo earlier snapshot for What changed

name: answer
summary: One API call of the React app, answered by server.py as the local server would: (status, body, sid); progress -> server.progress (st_react.py:34-35).

name: app
summary: The whole React app (web/src/App.tsx) as one component; a st.empty box above it shows a load's progress lines (st_react.py:89); each request answered through shown().

name: app.py
summary: Streamlit entry: page setup, blocked-component hint, st_react.app()

name: run.py
summary: Launcher: web|streamlit, --fake [twin] --scale, --direct/--objects, --port, --export [--fresh] / --build, --cache-dir

name: SP_ACCESS_SNAPSHOT
summary: Owner's-rights Python procedure filling the 9 TBL_ACCESS_ data tables; every data set read at the highest level that answers (ACCOUNT_USAGE, INFORMATION_SCHEMA, SHOW; P_SOURCE = SHOW skips ACCOUNT_USAGE), database list once per run, object inventory as OWNERSHIP rows, one spelling per type (spell); run() skips if another run is RUNNING; FAILED drops its rows, OK drops older runs

name: get
summary: Cached GET /api/... via fetch or the Streamlit transport

name: startApp
summary: Installs the Streamlit transport: requests queued and sent as component value

name: What changed
summary: What changed feed (ChangeFeed): GET /api/changes with subject, f, offset (ev_at) and limit; a Pager over events_total

name: POST /api/reload
summary: Reload / load / rebuild

name: POST /api/mine/load
summary: Load My access

name: GET /api/changes
summary: What changed JSON (route per page name)

name: GET /api/home
summary: Home JSON (route per page name)

name: Table activity read (snapshot and direct, incremental)
summary: SP_ACCESS_SNAPSHOT history() or access.live() read ACCESS_HISTORY once for object use and activity (history_sql; each step reads alone if that fails), only the weeks / days the last read lacks, + QUERY_HISTORY + SESSIONS (app's QUERY_TAG left out), per UTC day with HOURS and APP; hours_of parses HOURS; build() fills acts; ACTIVITY=0 reads none of it

name: Activity tab request
summary: Object or Access page Activity tab (or the Access for UseLine) -> GET /api/activity -> activity_page -> kind branch (warehouse / app / scope / object), act_state, activity, activity_graph, activity_sensitive, query_sql, app_use, mark_sensitive, rule >= 24 findings -> stacked access log

name: SQL behind a page
summary: SQL button or right-click -> SqlPanel -> GET /api/sql -> sql_page -> page_sql -> query_file / plain / activity_section_sql -> SqlBox; Activity sections via section_sql -> Sec SQL button

name: Progress lines while reading Snowflake
summary: Load or Rebuild -> tracked(key, view, fn) -> a.progress(add) (+ heartbeat every BEAT s) -> live / snapshot / mine / each / a.step call a.say() -> PROGRESS[key].lines (+ terminal when LOG_LINES) -> GET /api/progress {running, view, lines, job} (local: LoadLog or the top-bar refresh indicator polls) or st_react.shown (inside Snowflake); until an answer comes the page shows Waiting (kit.tsx: Loading… N s, after 10 s a still-working hint)

name: Two-stage load: export (parts), then build
summary: Load or run.py --export -> with_query(cache.parted) -> each() hands waves to keep() -> parts from .cache/reads/<key>/ (pyarrow.parquet, else DuckDB) or Snowflake -> snapshot / live dict -> a whole load prunes the parts it did not ask for -> cache.store (.pkl, SQL copy thread) -> built(): a.build + rule checks, rule 17 and breaks, saved (or kept_rules), sensitive objects -> pages; run.py --build does stage 2 only

name: Background refresh (Rebuild snapshot / Read Snowflake again)
summary: POST /api/reload -> reload -> refresh: JOB running, thread -> renew: [CALL SP_ACCESS_SNAPSHOT] -> read_shared(KEY.new) -> built -> cache.swap -> compared (What changed made now); pages keep the old data; App.tsx top-bar indicator polls /api/progress job until done, then clears its cache

name: Tables paged on the server
summary: DataTable (server=) / PagedTable / Pager -> GET privs | held | grantees | access | rules | review | sensitive | object | changes with offset, limit, q, sort, dir -> rows cached per data set, filtered, sorted, sliced (paged / window / num_param / review_slice) -> one page + total; CSV through /api/<name>.csv builds every row

name: Lazy graph box
summary: build_graph with src: over LAZY members crowded lanes fold (fold_lanes, MAX_LANE) and combined boxes go out empty (lazy, counts, ids); a click in Graph.tsx -> GET /api/graph?<src>&group=<box> -> graph_page -> the page graph with only=<box> -> that box with its members; map node= answers a box detail drawn later

name: Snapshot read levels
summary: Every snapshot data set (SP_ACCESS_SNAPSHOT and access.live) is read at the highest level that answers: ACCOUNT_USAGE, else one database's INFORMATION_SCHEMA, else SHOW; database list read once per run (database_list), schema list (schema_list) for SHOW FUTURE GRANTS, object inventory per kind (inventory_read); SOURCES says the level, NOTES why a lower one ran

name: Object inventory
summary: After the grants: inventory_sql kinds (tables, views, functions, ..., Streamlit apps, notebooks, alerts, warehouses) read per level; inventory_seen + inventory_rows add one OWNERSHIP row per object the grants lack (owner role, DB.ROLE, or no holder); procedure step objects saves them with spell(kind)

name: Object activity page
summary: GET /api/objuse -> objuse_page -> objuse_rows (days in PERIODS, scope=, tab unused | read_only | write_only | all, type=, q=, sort) -> access.object_activity() once per data set; shared only; CSV and a Home card from the same rows

name: Can they?
summary: GET /api/check -> check_page -> check_object: grants once, choices from ask_privs, USAGE chips (containers, usage_gaps), for a database or schema inside_page -> inside_access (read / DML / DDL, paged), a No with near=1 -> narrowest then nearest and nearest_own apart, risk strip of subject and object, Paths combined graph with focus=; priv=USAGE on an object without USAGE of its own -> container_usage (its database and schema)

name: Graph focus
summary: A click on a known box -> onOnly(id) -> page asks again with focus= (Map focus, User / Role tfocus) -> build_graph narrows first: narrow (open combined box, through, cut, way in walked back upstream) -> fold_lanes for crowded lanes -> focus {id, label, access: focus_access} -> bar with who has access and Show all

name: Access page
summary: Access.tsx tabs Overview / Objects / Privileges / Paths / Can run / Activity / History, a role also Held by, What it holds, All protected, Read-only writes (roleTabs); GET /api/access -> access_page + access_list (otype= type filter, filter, q, group, sort); Privileges, Paths and the role tabs embed one part (pane) of the User / Role page; risk strip from subject_risks

name: Home page and risk strip
summary: GET /api/home -> home_page (home_summary, home_cards) -> Home.tsx hero search (GET /api/find), then tabs Risks (Needs attention tiles from homedata.attention, unread sources left out; Act first, area cards) / At a glance / Changes; risk strip lines from subject_risks / object_risks, ranked, shown top 3 then +N more by RiskStrip, each with items opening its table in place
